title: "Lifetime sweeps"
output:

---
R code used to generate Figures 4A and D10

```{r, eval = F}
.vsc.attach()
setwd("R/kick_flow_sim")
```

```{r imports}
library(ggplot2)
library(data.table)

config = "rust_config.json"
```

```{r}
writeConfig <- function(
  path,
  desc,

  replicates = 1,
  rounds = 1000,
  seed = 93117,

  write_every = 1,
  print_every = 100,

  pop_size = 10000,
  inoc_size = 0.1,

  mort_to_disp = 1.5,
  patch_lifetime = 3,
  uniform_fraction = 0
) {
  txt <- sprintf('{
    "description": "%s",
    "replicates": %i,
    "rounds": %i,
    "seed": %i,
    "write_every": %i,
    "print_every": %i,

    "pop_size": %i,
    "inoc_size": %s,
    
    "mort_to_disp": %s,
    "patch_lifetime": %s,
    "uniform_fraction": %s
}', desc, replicates, rounds, seed,
    write_every, print_every,
    pop_size, inoc_size, 
    mort_to_disp, patch_lifetime, uniform_fraction)
  write(txt, file = path)
}

```

```{r}
survivor_plot <- function(data, min_biomass = 1, nr_reps = 1) {
  # split by replicate
  replicates <- split(data, data$V52)

  long_dfs <- lapply(replicates[seq(nr_reps)], function(df) {
    colnames(df) <- df[1, ]
    df <- df[-1, 1:51]
    points <- reshape2::melt(df, id.vars = 51)
    colnames(points) <- c("time", "alpha", "biomass")

    points$alpha <- as.numeric(as.character(points$alpha))
    points$time <- as.numeric(points$time)
    points[points$biomass > min_biomass, ]
  })

  for (df in long_dfs) {
    print(ggplot(df, aes(x = time, y = alpha, color = biomass)) +
      geom_point(size = 0.2) +
      theme_bw() +
      khroma::scale_color_YlOrBr(range = c(0.5, 1)))
  }
}
```


```{r}
lifetimes <- c(50, 500, 5000, 50000)
prefix <- "pub_"

results <- lapply(lifetimes, function(life) {
  desc <- paste0(prefix, life)
  result <- paste0("results/sweeps/", desc, "_zero.csv")
  if (!file.exists(result)) {
    writeConfig(
      config,
      desc,
      seed = 93117,

      replicates = 200,
      rounds = 20000,

      write_every = 50,
      print_every = 1000,

      pop_size = 100,
      inoc_size = 0.1,

      mort_to_disp = 24.1225,
      patch_lifetime = life,
      uniform_fraction = 0.01
    )
    command <- sprintf(
      r"[cargo run --release --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml --bin main -- %s %s]",
      config, result
    )
    code <- system(command)
  }
  result
})
```


### Check cutoffs
```{r}
for (var in lifetimes) {
```

### Histograms - Add infinite version

```{r}
binw <- 0.005

lifetimes <- c(lifetimes, "inf")
prefix <- "pub_"

biomasses <- lapply(lifetimes, function(life) {
  desc <- paste0(prefix, life)
  result <- paste0("results/sweeps/", desc, "_zero.csv")
  data <- read.table(result, sep = ",", comment.char = "#",
                     header = FALSE)

  if (life == "inf") {
    min_time <- 2000
  }
  else {
    min_time <- 200 * as.numeric(life)
  }

  replicates <- split(data, data$V52)

  biomasses <- lapply(replicates, function(df) {
    colnames(df) <- df[1,]
    df <- df[-1,]
    colnames(df)[51] <- "time"
    df <- df[df$time > min_time, 1:50]
    data.frame(alpha = as.numeric(colnames(df)), biomass = colSums(df) / nrow(df))
  })

  biomasses <- data.table::rbindlist(biomasses)

  biomasses$bin <- floor(biomasses$alpha / binw)
  biomasses
})

hist_data <- lapply(biomasses, function(biomasses) {
  hist_data <- aggregate(biomass ~ bin, biomasses, sum)
  # Normalize to relative frequency (proportion of total biomass)
  hist_data
})
names(hist_data) <- lifetimes
```

```{r}
combo <- rbindlist(hist_data, idcol = T)
combo$.id[combo$.id == "inf"] <- "Equilibrium"

colors <- c("#a1dab4", "#41b6c4", "#2c7fb8", "#253494", "#000000")
ggplot(combo, aes(
    xmin = bin * binw, xmax = (bin + 1) * binw,
    ymin = 0, ymax = biomass,

    x = bin * binw, y = biomass,

    fill = .id, color = .id
  )) +
  #geom_rect(aes(alpha = .id), color = NA, show.legend = F) +
  geom_step(linewidth = 1) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 0.2)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors) +
  scale_color_manual(values = colors) +
  scale_alpha_manual(values = c(0.2, 0.2, 0.2, 0.2, 0)) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    x = "Siderophore investment alpha", 
    y = "Proportion of total biomass across simulation", 
    color = "Expected patch\nlifetime") +
  theme(
    legend.position = "inside", legend.position.inside = c(0.8, 0.8),
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank())
```

## Density plot
```{r}
binw <- 0.005

lifetimes <- c(lifetimes, "inf")
prefix <- "pub_"

biomasses <- lapply(lifetimes, function(life) {
  desc <- paste0(prefix, life)
  result <- paste0("results/sweeps/", desc, "_zero.csv")
  data <- read.table(result, sep = ",", comment.char = "#",
                     header = FALSE)

  if (life == "inf") {
    min_time <- 2000
  }
  else {
    min_time <- 200 * as.numeric(life)
  }

  replicates <- split(data, data$V52)

  biomasses <- lapply(replicates, function(df) {
    colnames(df) <- df[1,]
    df <- df[-1,]
    colnames(df)[51] <- "time"
    df <- df[df$time > min_time, 1:50]
    data.frame(alpha = as.numeric(colnames(df)), biomass = colSums(df) / nrow(df))
  })

  biomasses <- data.table::rbindlist(biomasses)

  # Aggregate biomass by alpha across replicates before computing density
  biomasses <- aggregate(biomass ~ alpha, biomasses, sum)

  # Weighted kernel density estimate over alpha, weighted by biomass
  w <- biomasses$biomass / sum(biomasses$biomass)

  dens <- density(
    x = biomasses$alpha,
    weights = w,
    from = 0,
    to = 0.2,
    bw = binw
  )

  data.frame(
    alpha = dens$x,
    density = dens$y
  )
})

names(biomasses) <- lifetimes
```


```{r}
combo <- rbindlist(biomasses, idcol = TRUE)
combo$.id[combo$.id == "inf"] <- "Equilibrium"

colors <- c("#a1dab4", "#41b6c4", "#2c7fb8", "#253494", "#000000")
linetypes <- c("solid", "solid", "solid", "solid", "dashed")
plt <- ggplot(combo, aes(
    x = alpha, y = density,
    fill = .id, color = .id, linetype = .id
  )) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.109, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = linetypes) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 0.2)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors) +
  scale_color_manual(values = colors) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    x = "Siderophore investment alpha", 
    y = "Proportion of total biomass across simulation", 
    color = "Expected patch\nlifetime (1/μ)",
    linetype = "Expected patch\nlifetime (1/μ)"
    ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "inside", legend.position.inside = c(0.8, 0.8),
    legend.key.width = unit(1.5, "cm"),
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank())

plt
```

```{r}
combo <- rbindlist(hist_data, idcol = T)
combo$.id[combo$.id == "inf"] <- "Until\nEquilibrium"

colors <- c("#a1dab4", "#41b6c4", "#2c7fb8", "#253494", "#000000")
linetypes <- c("solid", "solid", "solid", "solid", "solid")

ggplot(combo, aes(
    xmin = bin * binw, xmax = (bin + 1) * binw,
    ymin = 0, ymax = biomass,

    fill = .id, color = .id, group = .id, linetype = .id
  )) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.109, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_ribbon(aes(alpha = .id), color = NA, show.legend = F) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 2) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 0.2)) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = linetypes) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors) +
  scale_color_manual(values = colors) +
  scale_alpha_manual(values = c(0.2, 0.2, 0.2, 0.2, 0)) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    x = "Siderophore investment alpha", 
    y = "Proportion of total biomass across simulation", 
    color = "Expected patch\nlifetime (1/μ)",
    linetype = "Expected patch\nlifetime (1/μ)"
    ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "inside", legend.position.inside = c(0.8, 0.8),
    legend.key.width = unit(1.5, "cm"),
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank())
```

```{r}
  biomasses <- lapply(replicates, function(df) {
    colnames(df) <- df[1,]
    df <- df[-1,]
    colnames(df)[51] <- "time"
    df <- df[df$time > min_time, 1:50]
    data.frame(alpha = as.numeric(colnames(df)), biomass = colSums(df) / nrow(df))
  })

  biomasses <- data.table::rbindlist(biomasses)

  # Aggregate biomass by alpha across replicates before computing density
  biomasses <- aggregate(biomass ~ alpha, biomasses, sum)

  # Weighted kernel density estimate over alpha, weighted by biomass
  w <- biomasses$biomass / sum(biomasses$biomass)

  dens <- density(
    x = biomasses$alpha,
    weights = w,
    from = 0,
    to = 0.2,
    bw = binw
  )

  data.frame(
    alpha = dens$x,
    density = dens$y
  )
})

names(biomasses) <- lifetimes
```


```{r}
combo <- rbindlist(biomasses, idcol = TRUE)
combo$.id[combo$.id == "inf"] <- "Equilibrium"

colors <- c("#a1dab4", "#41b6c4", "#2c7fb8", "#253494", "#000000")
linetypes <- c("solid", "solid", "solid", "solid", "dashed")
plt <- ggplot(combo, aes(
    x = alpha, y = density,
    fill = .id, color = .id, linetype = .id
  )) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.109, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = linetypes) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 0.2)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors) +
  scale_color_manual(values = colors) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    x = "Siderophore investment alpha", 
    y = "Proportion of total biomass across simulation", 
    color = "Expected patch\nlifetime (1/μ)",
    linetype = "Expected patch\nlifetime (1/μ)"
    ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "inside", legend.position.inside = c(0.8, 0.8),
    legend.key.width = unit(1.5, "cm"),
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank())
```
